runner.method: Before every mutant: rewrite every subject from HEAD, check its sha256, and run the mutant's test files unmutated, which must pass. Then apply the mutant (every edit's `old` must occur exactly once, a pair through `also`), run `npx vitest run --project @syzygy/polaris-generation-provider <tests>`, and restore and re-check every subject. Killed = at least one failed test.
